blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Suncrest fell from 4 in June to 3 in October (−25.0%), and 6 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.7% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.

items.t: Upper Deer Lake houses for sale
The stock is all detached houses, which is what sets Suncrest apart from the tower stock of Metrotown immediately to the north and from the mixed stock of the Royal Oak station area to the east.

blocks.text: Suncrest Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Lewarne Park, on Macpherson Avenue at Rumble Street, sits on the eastern seam with South Slope in the Royal Oak community, so the pocket's park investment is shared with its eastern neighbour.
The 146 bus loop's turn on Rumble Street between Joffre Avenue and Patterson Avenue traces the pocket more precisely than any neighbourhood map the City publishes for Suncrest.
Burnaby South Secondary at 5455 Rumble Street anchors the northeast corner, so the school, not a shopping street, is the pocket's northeast landmark.
The 146 Metrotown Station and Suncrest loop runs on Rumble Street between Joffre Avenue and Patterson Avenue, tying the pocket to Metrotown Station to the north.
Marine Drive is the slope's bottom street to the south, and Rumble Street is the top street of the South Slope hill frame that Suncrest shares.

Suncrest home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Suncrest with a median price of $1,550,000 (the middle half sold between $1,415,000 and $1,590,000), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $640 per square foot, a median year built of 1956 and a median lot of 7,020 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Suncrest?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 houses listed in Suncrest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Suncrest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Suncrest had a sales ratio of 33% on only 3 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Suncrest from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Suncrest over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Suncrest?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
